Orders domain

Payment

The act of paying for magical goods or services.

Purchase Order

A mystical document issued by a buyer to a seller indicating the types, quantities, and agreed prices for enchanted products or services.

Read more

Order Line

An individual enchanted item within a purchase order, representing a specific magical product or service being ordered.

Read more

SKU

Sorcery Keeping Unit - A unique identifier for distinct magical products and their variants in inventory.

Read more

Consignment

A batch of enchanted goods destined for or delivered to someone.

Read more

Invoice

A document issued by a seller to a buyer, listing enchanted goods or services provided and the amount due.

Read more

Supplier

An entity that provides enchanted goods or services to another organization.

Read more

Inventory

The complete list of enchanted items held in stock by a business.

Fulfillment

The process of completing an order and delivering it to the customer.

The process of sending back enchanted goods to the seller for a refund or exchange.
